datasets.title: Gentamicin effect on fur-deficient cells (GDS5162)
datasets.why: differential expression on 12 Escherichia coli; Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655 samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of Δfur and wildtype cells treated with the bacterial antibiotic gentamicin and harvested 1 hr post-treatment. Fur is the master regulator of iron metabolism in E. coli. Results provide insight into Fur's influence on the magnitude of stress responses triggered by bactericidal antibiotics.

datasets.title: Multiple bactericidal antibiotics (GDS5160)
datasets.why: differential expression on 18 Escherichia coli; Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655 samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of wild-type cells treated with various antibiotics or hydrogen peroxide and harvested 1 hour post-treatment. Results provide insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying antibiotic lethality.

datasets.title: Escherichia coli O157:H7 response to cinnamaldehyde: time course (GDS4321)
datasets.why: differential expression on 8 Escherichia coli; Escherichia coli O157:H7 samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of E. coli O157:H7 exposed to cinnamaldehyde (CIN) for up to 4 hours. CIN is a natural antimicrobial effective against many foodborne pathogens including Escherichia coli O157:H7. Results provide insight into molecular processes underlying CIN-induced transient inhibition of E. coli.

datasets.title: Escherichia coli response to the arylamide compound PMX 10070: time course (GDS4815)
datasets.why: differential expression on 18 Escherichia coli samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of Escherichia coli cells treated with a sublethal concentration of the antimicrobial arylamide compound PMX 10070 for 20 and 60 minutes. Arylamides permeabilize E. coli membranes. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms underlying the antibacterial action of arylamides.

datasets.title: Increased cell membrane saturated fatty acid effect on Escherichia coli (GDS3597)
datasets.why: differential expression on 6 Escherichia coli samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of Escherichia coli cells treated with CHIR-090, an inhibitor of lipid A bioynthesis, to increase the ratio of saturated to unsaturated fatty acids (SFA:UFA) in the cell membrane. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms regulating membrane lipid homeostasis in E. coli.

datasets.title: Frag1 cells response to ionic and non-ionic hyperosmotic stress (GDS3421)
datasets.why: differential expression on 6 Escherichia coli samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of bacterial Frag1 cells subjected to ionic (NaCl) and non-ionic (sucrose) hyperosmotic stress (HS). Results provide insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying the specificity of osmotic adjustment to ionic and non-ionic osmotica.

datasets.title: Stress factor RpoS regulon in exponential-phase bacteria (GDS3123)
datasets.why: differential expression on 6 Escherichia coli K-12 samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of rpoS knockout mutants of bacteria K-12 strain MG1655 cells in exponential phase. RpoS, an alternative sigma factor and a stress response regulator, is a major regulator of genes required for stationary phase adaptation. Results provide insight into the role of RpoS in exponential phase.

datasets.title: Enterohemorrhagic Escherichia coli response to epinephrine, norepinephrine, and indole (GDS2879)
datasets.why: differential expression on 4 Escherichia coli samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of enterohemmorhagic Escherichia coli (EHEC) O157:H7 treated with epinephrine (EP), norepinephrine (NE), and indole. During infection in the gastrointestinal tract, EHEC is exposed to a wide range of signaling molecules such as EP and NE, and bacterial signaling molecules such as indole.

datasets.title: Benzalkonium chloride adapted E. coli K12 (GDS2825)
datasets.why: differential expression on 22 Escherichia coli samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of E. coli K12 strains adapted to grow in benzalkonium chloride (BC). BC is a commonly used disinfectant and preservative. Results provide insight into the molecular basis of this resistance.

datasets.title: Enterohemorrhagic Escherichia coli biofilm response to 7-hydroxyindole and isatin (GDS2753)
datasets.why: differential expression on 4 Escherichia coli samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of enterohemorrhagic Escherichia coli biofilm treated with 7-hydroxyindole or oxidized indole (isatin). Many bacterial oxygenases readily convert indole, an interspecies biofilm signal, into oxidized compounds. Results provide insight into the role of oxidized indoles in biofilm formation.

datasets.title: Arginine regulon repression and derepression (GDS2427)
datasets.why: differential expression on 9 Escherichia coli samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of cells with the arginine (Arg) regulon fully or partially repressed, or derepressed. Genes of the Arg regulon are coordinately repressed by the Arg repressor (ArgR) in response to Arg. Results provide insight into ArgR-mediated repression of arginine biosynthesis and uptake genes.

datasets.title: Ozone effect on G-protein double-null mutant leaves: time course (GDS4378)
datasets.why: differential expression on 27 Arabidopsis thaliana samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of leaves from G-protein double mutant gpa1-4/agb1-2 plants with null mutations in the α- and β-subunits that were exposed to 125 ppb ozone for up to 2 days. Results provide insight into the role of G-protein signaling pathways in plant response to ozone exposure.

datasets.title: Salt stress effect on multiple genotypes: leaf (GDS3927)
datasets.why: differential expression on 12 Arabidopsis thaliana samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of leaf from salt-stressed plants with genotypes Wassilewskija (Ws), Columbia (Col) and single gene mutation (glabrous, gl1-1) in the Col background. Ws plants had the least salt injury. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms underlying variation in salt stress responses.

datasets.title: High light stress effect on cell suspension cultures containing functional chloroplasts (GDS3933)
datasets.why: differential expression on 9 Arabidopsis thaliana samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of Arabidopsis cell suspension culture (ACSC), containing functional chloroplasts, subjected to high light. Several reactive oxygen species (ROS) are generated under HL conditions. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms underlying early defense responses to HL stress.

datasets.title: Non-symbiotic hemoglobin AtHb1 overexpression effect on seeds under moderate hypoxia (GDS3888)
datasets.why: differential expression on 12 Arabidopsis thaliana samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of siliques from transgenic plants overexpressing AtHb1 and exposed to control (normoxic) and moderate hypoxic conditions. AtHb1 overexpression mediates a pre-adaptation to hypoxic stress. Results provide insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying AtHb1 function.

datasets.title: Auxin effect on seedlings (GDS3823)
datasets.why: differential expression on 6 Arabidopsis thaliana samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of seedlings treated with auxin only or auxin plus brassinazole (a brassinosteroid (BR) biosynthetic inhibitor). Auxin induces expression of DWARF4. The DWARF4 enzyme catalyzes the rate-determining step in BR biosynthesis. Results provide insight into the role of auxin in BR biosynthesis.

datasets.title: Pollinated pistils: time course (GDS3905)
datasets.why: differential expression on 10 Arabidopsis thaliana samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of pistils up to 8.0 hours after pollination. Unfertilized ovules were also examined. An intense pollen-pistil interaction precedes fertilization. Results provide insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying sexual plant reproduction.

datasets.title: Phosphate deficiency effect on roots: time course (GDS3896)
datasets.why: differential expression on 24 Arabidopsis thaliana samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of roots from plants grown in the absence of phosphate (Pi) for up to 24 hrs. Pi deficiency-induces the formation of root hairs with increased length and density. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms involved in acclimating plants to low Pi availability.

datasets.title: Suspension cell cultures response to overexpression of master regulators VND6 and SND1 (GDS3934)
datasets.why: differential expression on 18 Arabidopsis thaliana samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of suspension cell lines in which VASCULAR-RELATED NAC-DOMAIN6 (VND6) or SECONDARY WALL-ASSOCIATES NAC DOMAIN PROTEIN1 (SND1) was overexpressed after the addition of estrogen. Results provide insight in to the roles of master regulators VND6 and SND1 in xylem development.

datasets.title: Salt stress effect on mannitol-producing, salt-tolerant M6PR transgenic plant: leaf (GDS3918)
datasets.why: differential expression on 8 Arabidopsis thaliana samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of leaf from mannose-6-phosphate reductase (M6PR) transgenic plants subjected to salt stress (100mM NaCl). M6PR transgenics were dramatically more salt tolerant relative to the wild type. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms of mannitol-enhanced, stress tolerance in plants.

datasets.title: GR24 effect on strigolactone-deficient mutant seedlings (GDS3583)
datasets.why: differential expression on 4 Arabidopsis thaliana samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of ecotype Columbia, strigolactone (SL)-deficient mutant seedlings treated with GR24 (1uM), a synthetic SL analog. SLs regulate shoot branching. Results provide insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying SL signaling.

datasets.title: Norflurazon effect on whole seedlings (GDS3379)
datasets.why: differential expression on 18 Arabidopsis thaliana samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of 5-day-old, light-grown gun1-9 and gun5 mutant whole seedlings treated with norflurazon, an inhibitor of chloroplast development. GUN1 and GUN5 are involved in plastid-to-nucleus retrograde signaling. Results provide insight into nuclear genes under the control of retrograde pathways.

datasets.title: Greening after extended darkness 1 (ged1) mutant seedlings (GDS3535)
datasets.why: differential expression on 6 Arabidopsis thaliana samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of ged1 mutant seedlings grown for 5 days in the dark followed by 2 days in the light. The ged1 mutant showed an enhanced ability to green on illumination after prolonged darkness. Results provide insight into the molecular basis of the enhanced greening ability of ged1 seedlings.

datasets.title: Cereal crop reproductive development: anther (Agilent) (GDS3957)
datasets.why: differential expression on 16 Oryza sativa samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of anther development across multiple stages from hypodermal archesporial cells formation (Stage ID: An1) to tri-cellular mature pollen (Stage ID: P3). The same RNA samples were used for Agilent and Affymetrix experiments. Results provide insight into the reliability of the Affymetrix data.

datasets.title: Cereal crop reproductive development: multiple stages and organs (Affymetrix) (GDS3956)
datasets.why: differential expression on 98 Oryza sativa samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of 25 finely dissected stages/organs of the reproductive process encompassing anther development, pollination-fertilization, and embryogenensis. Vegetative tissues were used as controls. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms underlying the reproductive process.

datasets.title: Rice leaves response to blast fungus infection: time course (GDS3441)
datasets.why: differential expression on 8 Oryza sativa samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of leaves of rice cultivar Nipponbare 3 or 4 days following inoculation with the virulent Magnaporthe grisea FR13 isolate. M. grisea causes blast. Results provide insight into the molecular basis of the susceptibility of rice to blast.

datasets.title: Benzothiadiazole effect on Oryza sativa leaves (GDS3070)
datasets.why: differential expression on 8 Oryza sativa samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of leaves of Oryza sativa plants treated with benzothiadiazole (BTH). BTH is a functional analog of salicylic acid and enhances the resistance of rice to the fungal pathogen Rhizoctonia solani. Results provide insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying BTH-induced disease resistance.

datasets.title: Silent Information Regulator 2-related gene OsSRT1 knockdown effect on rice leaves (GDS2694)
datasets.why: differential expression on 6 Oryza sativa samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of rice leaves following RNAi knockdown of OsSRT1, a Silent Information Regulator 2 (SIR2)-related gene. Members of the SIR2 family are NAD(+)-dependent histone deacetylases. OsSRT1is one of the two SIR2-related genes found in rice. Results provide insight into the function of OsSRT1.

datasets.title: Anoxia effect on rice coleoptiles (GDS2631)
datasets.why: differential expression on 4 Oryza sativa samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of coleoptiles of rice grown under anaerobic conditions. Rice seeds are capable of germinating in the absence of oxygen. Under anoxia, rice coleoptiles reach lengths greater than that of aerobically grown rice. Results provide insight into the control of anaerobic carbohydrate metabolism.

datasets.title: Cytokinin-inducible type-A response regulator OsRR6 overexpression effect on rice leaves (GDS2633)
datasets.why: differential expression on 4 Oryza sativa samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of transgenic rice leaves overexpressing OsRR6, a cytokinin (CK)-inducible type-A response regulator. Results provide insight into the role of OsRR6 in CK signaling and further the understanding of the function of CK in rice.

datasets.title: Cytokinin effect on rice roots and leaves: time course (GDS2632)
datasets.why: differential expression on 24 Oryza sativa samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of rice roots and leaves 30 and 120 minutes after treatment with the cytokinin trans-zeatin (tZ). Cytokinins (CKs) are a class of plant hormones that regulate the growth and development of plants. Results provide insight into the molecular mechanisms regulated by CK in rice.

datasets.title: Lipopolysaccharide and chitin oligosaccharide effect on rice cells (GDS2480)
datasets.why: differential expression on 4 Oryza sativa; Oryza sativa Japonica Group samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of rice cells treated with lipopolysaccharide or N-acetylchitooctaose. These agents are pathogen-associated molecular pattern (PAMP) molecules important in the innate immune response. Results provide insight into the cellular response to PAMP molecules.

datasets.title: Sodium arsenate effect on Azucena and Bala varieties (GDS1800)
datasets.why: differential expression on 8 Oryza sativa samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Expression profiling of 1-week-old roots from varieties Azucena and Bala following treatment with 1 ppm sodium arsenate. Results provide insight into the molecular basis of arsenate tolerance exhibited by the Bala variety.

datasets.title: Salinity stress response (GDS1383)
datasets.why: differential expression on 11 Oryza sativa; Oryza sativa Indica Group samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of crown and growing point of salt-tolerant (FL478) and salt-sensitive (IR29) genotypes under control and salinity-stressed conditions during vegetative growth. Results provide insight into the genetic basis of salt tolerance in rice.

datasets.title: CBF3 and ABF3 overexpressing transgenic leaves tolerative response to drought (GDS1798)
datasets.why: differential expression on 12 Oryza sativa samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of transgenic leaves from plants constitutively expressing Arabidopsis CBF3 or ABF3 following exposure to drought. CBF3 and ABF3 function in distinct stress-response pathways. Results demonstrate ectopic expression of CBF3 or ABF3 enhances stress tolerance.

datasets.title: Heritable pulmonary arterial hypertension: cardiac right ventricular wall (GDS5610)
datasets.why: differential expression on 6 Homo sapiens samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of biopsies of right ventricle (RV) from patients with pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) with bone morphogenetic protein receptor type II (BMPR2) mutation. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms underlying the metabolic effects of mutant BMPR2 in PAH RVs.

datasets.title: Sirtuin-1 activator resveratrol effect on adult secondary neurospheres (GDS5612)
datasets.why: differential expression on 4 Mus musculus samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of adult secondary neurospheres derived from hippocampal neural stem cells/neural progenitor cells and treated with resveratrol, an activator of NAD-dependent histone deacetylase Sirtuin-1 (Sirt1). Results provide insight into the role of Sirt1 in adult hippocampal neurogenesis.

datasets.title: Sirtuin-1 deficiency effect on adult secondary neurospheres (GDS5611)
datasets.why: differential expression on 4 Mus musculus samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of adult secondary neurospheres derived from hippocampal neural stem cells/neural progenitor cells of sirtuin-1 knockout mice. Sirt1 is a nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD)-dependent histone deacetylase. Results provide insight into the role of Sirt1 in adult hippocampal neurogenesis.

datasets.title: Circadian modulators SHARP1/SHARP2 deficiency effect on cortex: time course (GDS5423)
datasets.why: differential expression on 8 Mus musculus samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of cortex from SHARP1/2 double null mutants at ZT4 (wake phase) and ZT16 (sleep phase). bHLH transcription factors SHARP1 (DEC2, BHLHE41) and SHARP2 (DEC1, BHLHE40) are circadian modulators. Results provide insight into the molecular contributions of SHARP1/SHARP2 to the sleep-wake cycle.

datasets.title: Left ventricle myocardium from MerCreMer model of transient cardiomyopathy: time course (GDS5469)
datasets.why: differential expression on 19 Mus musculus samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Temporal analysis of left ventricle myocardium from the MCM model of cardiomyopathy. Transient cardiomyopathy develops in this model after 5 day exposure to tamoxifen, with peak heart failure (HF) at day 10, and resolved HF at day 28. Results provide insight into the molecular basis of evolving HF.

datasets.title: Ethanol effect on lymphoblastoid cell lines from alcoholics (GDS5430)
datasets.why: differential expression on 84 Homo sapiens samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of lymphoblastoid cell lines (LCLs), obtained from alcoholics, after treatment with ethanol in vitro. Results provide insight into the feasibility of using LCLs to study the molecular consequences of exposure to alcohol.

datasets.title: Streptozotocin-induced type 1 diabetes model: brain hypothalamus (GDS5344)
datasets.why: differential expression on 17 Mus musculus samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of hypothalamus from streptozotocin-induced diabetic males (a model of insulin-deficient, type 1 diabetes). The hypothalamus controls the endocrine system, appetite and energy balance. Results provide molecular insight into how diabetes affects hypothalamic function.

datasets.title: Dietary vitamin D3 supplementation effect on hippocampus: dose effect (GDS5345)
datasets.why: differential expression on 26 Rattus norvegicus samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of hippocampus from F344 rats fed dietary supplement of cholecalciferol (vitamin D3) at doses of 10,000, 1000 and 100 IU/kg diet for 18 weeks. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms underlying vitamin D-mediated synaptic function enhancement.

datasets.title: Articular and growth plate cartilage zones: 10-day old normal proximal tibia (GDS5434)
datasets.why: differential expression on 12 Rattus norvegicus samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of superficial (SZ) and intermediate/deep (IDZ) zones microdissected from articular cartilage and resting (RZ) zone from growth plate cartilage of proximal tibial epiphyses of 10-day old rats. Results provide insight into molecular basis of articular and growth plate cartilage divergence.

datasets.title: Homeobox protein Nanog transcription factor overexpression effect on colon and intestine cells (GDS5376)
datasets.why: differential expression on 8 Mus musculus samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of colon and intestine cells with ectopic Nanog protein expression. Aggressive tumor progression and poor patient diagnosis have been associated with Nanog expression in different types of tumors. Results provide insight into the role of Nanog in tumor initiation.

datasets.title: Fezf2 overexpresson effect on cortical neural progenitors in vivo: time course (GDS5297)
datasets.why: differential expression on 14 Mus musculus samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of cortical neural progenitor cells overexpressing forebrain expressed zinc finger 2 (Fezf2) for 24 and 48 hours. Fezf2 expression vectors delivered to cells in utero. Results provide insight into the role of Fezf2 in the differentiation of corticospinal motor neurons from progenitors.

datasets.title: Transcription factor Cabut deficiency and overexpression effects on heads: time course (GDS5657)
datasets.why: differential expression on 6 Drosophila melanogaster samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of heads from strains overexpressing Cabut (cbtOE) or depleted for Cabut (cbtRNAi) at two time points during the day-night cycle (i.e., 3 hr after light-on or light-off). Krüppel‐like factors Klf10 and Klf11 are close mammalian homologs of cbt. Results provide insight into role of CBT.

datasets.title: Larval brains and imaginal discs with centrosome loss or amplification (GDS4499)
datasets.why: differential expression on 15 Drosophila melanogaster samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of 3rd instar larval brains and imaginal discs that lack centrosomes (DSas-4 and DSas-6) or have too many centrosomes (SakOE). Centrosome defects are common to many cancers. Results provide insight into the effects of centrosome loss or amplification on cell physiology.

datasets.title: Ionizing radiation effect on p53 mutant third instar larvae wing imaginal discs: time course (GDS4611)
datasets.why: differential expression on 16 Drosophila melanogaster samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of p53 mutant larvae wing imaginal discs up to 18hr after exposure to ionizing radiation (IR). Results provide insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying IR-induced, p53-independent apoptosis in larvae.

datasets.title: Segmental monosomy (GDS4494)
datasets.why: differential expression on 44 Drosophila melanogaster samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of adult females representing segmental deficiencies (Df), both as single Df/+ genotypes and in pairwise Df combinations. Aneuploidies such as segmental monosomy are associated with developmental abnormalities. Results provide insight into the effects of aneuploidies on the transcriptome.

datasets.title: Wing disc response to Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor signaling perturbations (GDS4496)
datasets.why: differential expression on 6 Drosophila melanogaster samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of third instar wing disc from EGFR dominant negative (71B-Gal4; UAS EgfrDN) and EGFR activated (71B-GAL4; UAS EgfrACT) larvae. Aberrant signaling of highly conserved EGFR pathway is implicated in a number of diseases. Results provide insight into the identity of new EGFR-responsive genes.

datasets.title: Phagocytic receptor Eater depleted hemocyte-derived cell line response to phagocytosed bacteria: time course (GDS4438)
datasets.why: differential expression on 24 Drosophila melanogaster samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of phagocytic receptor Eater depleted hemocyte-derived S2 cells after phagocytosing bacteria for up to 180 minutes. Results provide insight into the role of Eater in the transcriptional regulation of genes that are induced after bacterial binding and phagocytosis.

datasets.title: Male and female genital imaginal discs during early morphogenesis: time course (GDS3871)
datasets.why: differential expression on 24 Drosophila melanogaster samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of female or male genital discs dissected during early morphogenesis (L3, P6, or P20). In flies, the sex-determination hierarchy terminates in the doublesex (dsx) gene. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms downstream of dsx underlying sex-specific differentiation of genitalia.

datasets.title: Early neuronal development: embryos (GDS3854)
datasets.why: differential expression on 31 Drosophila melanogaster samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of atonal-expressing (atoGFP+) and atoGFP- cells from transgenic wild type and ato-mutant embryos, at 3 time points corresponding to the first 3hr of neural development. Results provide insight into how proneural factors such as ato regulate specialized neuronal differentiation pathways.

datasets.title: Drosophila development: parental species and interspecific hybrids (GDS3835)
datasets.why: differential expression on 48 Drosophila melanogaster; Drosophila sechellia; Drosophila si samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of males of 3 species (melanogaster, sechellia, simulans) and D. sechellia x D. simulans F1 hybrids during 4 developmental stages. Results within and between pure species and hybrids provide insight into both the evolution of gene regulation in the context of development and speciation.

datasets.title: Chronic hypoxia effect on dmDys model of Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy: single whole animal (GDS4201)
datasets.why: differential expression on 16 Drosophila melanogaster samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of 3-5 day-old dystrophin-deficient animals exposed to chronic hypoxia (CH) for 2 weeks. Respiratory muscle necrosis in late-stage DMD is associated with respiratory insufficiency and CH. Results provide insight into the effects of CH on dystrophin-deficient muscle in vivo.

datasets.title: Acute ethanol exposure: time course (GDS3707)
datasets.why: differential expression on 16 Drosophila melanogaster samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of heads of animals exposed to ethanol vapor for up to 240 minutes. Increased ethanol intake is facilitated by the development of tolerance to the aversive and pleasurable effects of ethanol. Results provide insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying ethanol tolerance development.

datasets.title: p24 deficiency (GDS3633)
datasets.why: differential expression on 12 Drosophila melanogaster samples, curated by NCBI
datasets.about: Analysis of abdominal and head/thorax segments of mutants lacking p24. Members of the p24 protein family are transmembrane constituents of the ER and Golgi-derived transport vesicles that function in trafficking secretory proteins. Results provide insight into the effect of the loss of p24 function.
